blurb.en: 16-algorithm stereo FX processor in 6HP: hall, shimmer, plate and spring reverbs, tape echo, ping-pong delay, chorus, flanger, ring mod, overdrive, compressor, freeze. Three knobs cover dry/wet, the algorithm's second parameter and volume/drive, with CV over everything including a meta-scan through all sixteen types.
blurb.fi: 16-algoritminen stereo-FX-prosessori 6HP:ssä: hall-, shimmer-, plate- ja spring-kaiut, tape echo, ping-pong-viive, chorus, flanger, rengasmodulaatio, overdrive, kompressori, freeze. Kolme nuppia hoitaa dry/wetin, algoritmin toisen parametrin ja volume/driven, ja kaikkea voi ohjata CV:llä, myös meta-skannausta kaikkien kuudentoista tyypin läpi.
blurb.sv: 16-algoritmers stereo-FX-processor i 6HP: hall-, shimmer-, plate- och spring-reverb, tape echo, ping-pong-delay, chorus, flanger, ringmodulering, overdrive, kompressor, freeze. Tre rattar sköter dry/wet, algoritmens andra parameter och volume/drive, med CV över allt inklusive en meta-scan genom alla sexton typer.

quotes.t: I'm not used to having the outputs on the top part of a module so I confused them for inputs a few times.
The Latin numbers on the effects' slots don't really mean anything so I always trying to remember which effect is at every slot.
